{"subject": "Checking in ahead of your Oct 30, 2026 review", "body": "Dear Lindqvist Household,

I hope you are well. As your adviser, I am writing ahead of your review due on Oct 30, 2026. Our last meeting was Oct 30, 2025, and you have been a client since 2010.

Your household holds USD 5,120,000 across 1 account, with cash of USD 108,560, or 2.1% of AUM. Your largest holding is a Total market ETF (VTI) at 64.1% of AUM. I would like to confirm these details with you before the review.

I also wanted to ask whether you know anyone who might benefit from a conversation with me. You have made 1 introduction in the past, and I am grateful for that trust. If someone comes to mind, I would welcome an introduction.

Please let me know a convenient time to talk.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield", "claims": [{"text": "Our last meeting was Oct 30, 2025", "source_field": "last_meeting_date"}, {"text": "you have been a client since 2010", "source_field": "client_since_year"}, {"text": "Your household holds USD 5,120,000 across 1 account", "source_field": "aum"}, {"text": "cash of USD 108,560, or 2.1% of AUM", "source_field": "cash_usd"}, {"text": "You have made 1 introduction in the past", "source_field": "referral_count"}]}
